title: kith-tui: owner is accountId, not ownerUserId
description: kith-tui aborts when the Session lacks ownerUserId and identifies the owner's messages by ownerUserId. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Session Object Extensions: ownerUserId is MAY for non-federating servers. Terminology: a client-facing reference to the owner carries the accountId. Message.senderId: 'The accountId for owner-composed messages'. jmap-testjig omits ownerUserId and sets senderId=testjig-account.
